name: Eugenio Castellotti
features: olive skin, thick dark hair swept back, dark eyes, handsome square face, strong jaw, athletic build, film-star confidence
bio: Il Bello — the beautiful one — and thought the finest Italian since Ascari. He took pole at Spa in 1955 at twenty-four, the youngest polesitter Formula One had then seen, and won the 1956 Mille Miglia outright in a downpour. He was killed testing at Modena in March 1957, aged 26, called back from holiday to answer a rival's lap time.
